roadmap.title: Complete an Assisted collectible run
roadmap.description: Follow the chronological route for all 56 files, 20 Charlie Dolls, 20 locks, four located weapons, three jewels, and the incidental combat achievements while learning the campaign and retaining manual saves.

roadmap.title: Clear the restricted Assisted run
roadmap.description: Finish Assisted without opening an Item Box and use only the one recovery item needed to remove the Power Station parasite; manage space with the starting slots and route Hip Pouches.

roadmap.title: Complete Hardcore
roadmap.description: Use unlocked Shop equipment to finish Hardcore, earn the Standard and Hardcore completion achievements, and unlock Nightmare.

roadmap.title: Complete Nightmare
roadmap.description: Carry the Shop setup through Nightmare to earn Conqueror and unlock Inferno.

roadmap.title: Earn the Inferno S rank
roadmap.description: Equip the Infinite Rocket Launcher and defensive Shop items, make no more than five manual saves, and finish Inferno in under two hours to stack the remaining difficulty, rank, and speed achievements.

achievements.summary: Survive the opening @enemy{Nemesis} chase and escape @loc{Jill's apartment building}.

guide.context: This achievement is an automatic story checkpoint immediately after Jill uses the bathroom sink.

steps.text: Follow the marked route through the collapsing apartment building until Jill reaches the street.

achievements.summary: Escape @loc{uptown Raccoon City} and reach Carlos after the helicopter encounter.

guide.context: The rescue occurs during the mandatory opening route and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Continue past the helicopter crash and evade Nemesis until Carlos rescues Jill.

achievements.description: Make it out of Downtown Raccoon City.
achievements.summary: Leave @loc{Downtown Raccoon City} after the encounter beyond Kendo's Gun Shop.

guide.context: Kendo's Gate Key opens the only onward route after the gun-shop cutscene.

steps.text: Take @item{Kendo's Gate Key} from the wall, unlock the gate beside the shop, and pass through the house.
Complete the ensuing Nemesis escape until the story moves Jill out of Downtown.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Nemesis} at @loc{Clock Tower Plaza} and finish the plaza sequence.

guide.context: This mandatory boss fight begins after Jill crosses the river from the Subway Tunnels.

steps.text: Damage Nemesis through every phase of the Clock Tower Plaza battle until the finishing cutscene begins.

achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Inferno difficulty}.

guide.context: Inferno unlocks only after a Nightmare clear, while Nightmare unlocks after Hardcore. Post-game Shop equipment is allowed.

steps.text: Complete Hardcore to unlock Nightmare, then complete Nightmare to unlock Inferno.
Start Inferno and finish the full campaign with any permitted Shop weapons or passive items.

achievements.summary: Craft any item by combining compatible materials in the inventory.

guide.context: Crafting is available early, and the station area supplies enough material for an immediate first recipe.

steps.text: Open the inventory, select a compatible material pair such as two Gunpowders, and confirm the combination.

achievements.summary: Attach any @item{weapon upgrade part} to its matching campaign weapon.

guide.context: The earliest upgrade is the Handgun Dot Sight in the Downtown Drugstore Storeroom safe.

steps.text: Open the Drugstore Storeroom safe with @mechanic{9 Left, 3 Right, 7 Left} and take the Handgun Dot Sight.
Combine the Handgun Dot Sight with Jill's handgun in the inventory.

achievements.estTime: under 1 minute in the Power Station
achievements.summary: Pick up any @item{Hip Pouch} to expand Jill's or Carlos's inventory.

guide.context: Six Hip Pouches exist, but the achievement requires only one inventory expansion.

steps.text: Take the Hip Pouch from the desk in the @loc{Subway Power Station Control Room}.

achievements.description: Force Nemesis to relinquish an item.
achievements.estTime: 1 minute during the first Downtown pursuit
achievements.summary: Incapacitate @enemy{Nemesis} during the first open Downtown pursuit and collect his dropped Supply Case.

guide.context: Nemesis awards one drop during each eligible pursuit; ordinary damage without forcing the case drop does not satisfy the requirement.

steps.text: After restoring subway power, hit Nemesis with a Hand Grenade during the first Downtown pursuit to force him to his knees.
Pick up Nemesis's Supply Case and open it to receive the Handgun Extended Magazine.

achievements.summary: Defeat the flamethrower-equipped @enemy{Nemesis} on the @loc{Demolition Site rooftop}.

guide.context: The rooftop is a mandatory boss arena reached during Jill's escape from the burning Demolition Site.

steps.text: Damage the flamethrower fuel tank, then keep attacking Nemesis until the rooftop battle ends.

achievements.description: Place all jewels in the clock tower monument.
achievements.summary: Insert the @item{Red, Green, and Blue Jewels} into the @loc{Redstone Street Station Clock Tower Monument}.

guide.context: Each jewel is sealed inside a Fancy Box that must be examined in the inventory; complete the route before permanently leaving Downtown.

steps.text: Take the Fancy Box from the @loc{Moon's Donuts safe room}, examine it, and remove the Red Jewel.
Use the Lock Pick on @loc{Toy Uncle Supershop}, then examine its Fancy Box to obtain the Green Jewel.
Cut the chain on the @loc{Supermarket} door with the Bolt Cutters, then examine its Fancy Box to obtain the Blue Jewel.
Return to Redstone Street Station and insert all three jewels into the Clock Tower Monument.

achievements.summary: Complete Carlos's objectives inside the @loc{Raccoon Police Department} and leave the station.

guide.context: Carlos's departure is a mandatory checkpoint after the station's final radio call.

steps.text: Finish every R.P.D. objective, make the radio call inside @loc{S.T.A.R.S. Office}, and head back toward the exit until control returns to Jill.

achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{zombie Brad} during Carlos's first visit to the @loc{R.P.D.}.

guide.context: Brad returns in the Safety Deposit Room if Carlos leaves him alive during the first encounter.

steps.text: Before entering the station, use Carlos's Assault Rifle to kill zombie Brad at the @loc{R.P.D. front entrance}, then take the ID Card from his body.

achievements.description: Complete the game with an S rank on Inferno.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{Inferno} in under 2 hours after making no more than 5 manual saves.

guide.context: A Hardcore clear unlocks Nightmare, and a Nightmare clear unlocks Inferno. Inferno disables autosaves; Continue preserves a failed attempt's elapsed time, while loading from the main menu discards it.

steps.text: Finish the story once, buy the Infinite Rocket Launcher, two Recovery Coins, two Iron Defense Coins, two Hip Pouches, and S.T.A.R.S. Field Combat Manual from @loc{Title Screen > Bonuses > Shop}, then retrieve that loadout from an Item Box.
Use no more than five manual saves, prioritizing difficult boss fights and the final Nemesis encounter.
After a death, quit to the main menu and load the latest manual save instead of selecting Continue.
Finish the campaign before the results timer reaches 2:00:00.

achievements.summary: Survive Carlos's timed @loc{Spencer Memorial Hospital lobby} defense.

guide.context: The siege begins after Carlos returns with the Vaccine Sample and is mandatory for story progress.

steps.text: Collect the Detonator after treating Jill and attach it to the explosive charge on the lobby pillar.
Defend the lobby until the timer expires and the explosive opens the escape route.

achievements.summary: Restore the @loc{Underground Storage} elevator and follow Nicholai into NEST 2.

guide.context: The achievement is an automatic story checkpoint after the warehouse fuse sequence.

steps.text: Collect the three warehouse fuses, install them in the elevator control panel, and ride to the Surveillance Room.
Watch the Nicholai cutscene and leave the Surveillance Room through the newly opened route.

achievements.description: Gather all the fuses in the warehouse within 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Collect and install all 3 @item{warehouse fuses} within 5 minutes of the Underground Storage power failure.

guide.context: The timer covers both collecting the fuses and returning them to the elevator panel; save in the preceding Underground Storage office for quick retries.

steps.text: Use the right elevator and take Fuse 3 from the control panel directly ahead.
Continue through the shelves, lower and cross the lift, ride the next elevator, descend the ladder, and take Fuse 1 where zombies break from the container.
Backtrack through the small storage room, unlock its shortcut, leave through the side door, descend the ladder, and take Fuse 2 beyond the Hunter.
Race back to the upper floor, place Fuse 1, Fuse 2, and Fuse 3 in the elevator panel, and finish before the five-minute cutoff.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Stage 2 Nemesis} in the @loc{NEST 2 Disposal Center}.

guide.context: This is the mandatory circular-pit battle after Jill synthesizes the vaccine.

steps.text: Attack Nemesis through the pit sequence until the finishing cutscene ends the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Stage 3 Nemesis} with the rail gun in @loc{NEST 2}.

guide.context: The rail gun must recharge between shots by restoring its displaced power cells around the arena.

steps.text: Take the rail gun and fire it into Nemesis.
Stun Nemesis's exposed weak points, then push every displaced power cell back into its socket.
Take the recharged rail gun and fire the finishing shot into Nemesis.

achievements.summary: Destroy any @item{Charlie Doll}; the earliest is in @loc{Redstone Street Station}.

guide.context: Charlie Doll progress is stored immediately in the profile record and persists between playthroughs.

steps.text: After Carlos rescues Jill, reverse direction and climb to street level; the Charlie Doll sits in the gap separating the pair of newspaper machines on the right.

achievements.description: Defeat two enemies with a single shot.
achievements.summary: Kill 2 enemies with a single shotgun or grenade-launcher blast.

guide.context: Any two enemies count if both deaths are caused by the same shot; clustered Drain Deimos provide an early setup.

steps.text: In the Subway Power Station parasite nest, wait until two Drain Deimos align in the same close-range lane.
Fire one shotgun blast through both Drain Deimos and confirm that both die from that shot.

achievements.summary: Read all @item{56 story files} across the campaign.

guide.context: File credit saves immediately to the profile record, so missing entries can be collected across playthroughs or by loading retained manual saves.

achievements.description: Complete the game on "Standard" or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Standard difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Difficulty achievements stack, so a Hardcore, Nightmare, or Inferno clear also awards the Standard completion.

steps.text: Start Standard or a higher difficulty and complete the campaign through the final results screen.

achievements.description: Complete the game on "Hardcore" or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Hardcore difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: A Hardcore clear unlocks Nightmare, and later difficulties also award the Hardcore completion.

steps.text: Complete the campaign on Hardcore, Nightmare, or Inferno.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Nightmare or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on @mechanic{Nightmare difficulty} or Inferno.

guide.context: Nightmare is unavailable until a Hardcore clear; completing Nightmare unlocks Inferno.

steps.text: Finish Hardcore once to add Nightmare to the difficulty menu.
Complete the campaign on Nightmare or Inferno.

achievements.description: Complete the game with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Make no more than 5 manual saves, then finish Assisted under 2 hours 30 minutes, Standard under 2 hours, Hardcore under 1 hour 45 minutes, or Nightmare/Inferno under 2 hours.

guide.context: Shop equipment is allowed, so the post-game Infinite Rocket Launcher can shorten any chosen S-rank route.

steps.text: Select a difficulty and plan a route below that difficulty's S-rank time threshold.
Make no more than five manual saves during the campaign.
Complete the final battle and reach the results screen before the selected difficulty's time limit.

achievements.description: Complete the game without opening the item box.
achievements.summary: Finish an entire campaign without opening any @item{Item Box}.

guide.context: Assisted supplies four extra starting inventory slots. Shop weapons cannot be used because retrieving them from storage would invalidate the restriction.

steps.text: Start Assisted difficulty and never activate the large black Item Box in any safe room.
Collect Hip Pouches, discard spent key items when prompted, and skip the two-slot MGL Grenade Launcher if space becomes tight.
Complete the final battle and reach the results screen without an Item Box interaction.

achievements.description: Complete the game using 1 or fewer recovery items.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign after using no more than 1 @item{Herb, Mixed Herb, or First Aid Spray}.

guide.context: Recovery Coins restore health passively and do not increase the recovery-item counter. Reserve the sole consumable heal for removing the mandatory Power Station parasite.

steps.text: After the first clear, retrieve one or two Recovery Coins from the Item Box at the start of a new run.
In the Subway Power Station nest, use one recovery item after a Drain Deimos infects Jill to remove the parasite.
Use no additional Herbs, Mixed Herbs, or First Aid Sprays before completing the campaign.

achievements.description: Complete the game in under 2 hours of play time.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign with less than @mechanic{2 hours of results-screen play time}.

guide.context: Assisted difficulty and post-game Shop weapons are permitted. After a death, loading from the main menu discards the failed attempt's elapsed time, whereas Continue retains it.

steps.text: Equip the Infinite Rocket Launcher and route only mandatory objectives.
If Jill or Carlos dies, return to the main menu and load the latest save instead of selecting Continue.
Defeat Stage 3 Nemesis and reach the results screen before the timer reaches 2:00:00.
